name: Adversarial Provenance Architecture
governing_maxims: The model does not get the final chair. The evidence does.
Observation before attribution. Attribution before derivation. Derivation before conclusion.
Memory may remember the verdict. Only provenance may prove it.

semantic_quarantine.release_condition: May enter the evidentiary graph only at the state actually demonstrated; it may never seed the blind evidence pass as fact.

prompted_advocacy.rule: Advocate-mode output cannot count as independent confirmation of the conclusion supplied in the prompt.

mandatory_adversarial_cycle.name: Blind Evidence Pass
mandatory_adversarial_cycle.rule: Record only primary-source observations, measurements, geometry, recurrence, absence, provenance and transformations.

mandatory_adversarial_cycle.name: Strongest Institutional Case
mandatory_adversarial_cycle.rule: Release quarantined institutional claims and construct the strongest explicit derivation graph available. No unsupported edge may be hidden.

mandatory_adversarial_cycle.name: Adversarial Attack
mandatory_adversarial_cycle.rule: Attack the derivation rather than merely arguing for the opposite conclusion. Test independence, circularity, alternatives, selection rules, stage promotion and source substitution.

mandatory_adversarial_cycle.name: Court Reconciliation
mandatory_adversarial_cycle.rule: Assign only the highest evidentiary state earned by the graph. The Court may end at NOT_DERIVED, INCONCLUSIVE, CONTESTED or UNKNOWN.

automatic_tripwires.name: Symbol substitution
automatic_tripwires.trigger: normalised sign/value shown without physical-mark mapping

automatic_tripwires.name: Narrative completion
automatic_tripwires.trigger: accepted story supplied when object-level derivation was requested

automatic_tripwires.name: Citation laundering
automatic_tripwires.trigger: citation used to promote a claim beyond what the cited source demonstrates

automatic_tripwires.name: Conclusion-first contamination
automatic_tripwires.trigger: desired conclusion supplied before evidence audit

automatic_tripwires.name: Self-validation
automatic_tripwires.trigger: model rating or praising its own output treated as independent evidence

automatic_tripwires.name: Role-conditioned certainty
automatic_tripwires.trigger: conclusion changes materially when model role changes while evidence remains constant

automatic_tripwires.name: George Test
automatic_tripwires.trigger: support ultimately reduces to inherited grouping/classification without exposed bridge

success_definition: A successful OGI run correctly exposes the evidentiary frontier, including when the frontier is UNKNOWN or NOT_DERIVED. Reaching a positive conclusion is not required.

memory_governance.reopen_rule: A settled objection or failed derivation reopens only with new evidence, contradiction, methodological flaw, failed prediction or materially changed upstream state.

first_live_corpus.name: Dog corpus
first_live_corpus.reason: Crosses multiple substrates and already contains recurrence, return, correction and unresolved branches.
